name: Baikoku Ouki ~Daraku no Mesu Buta Oyako~
original_name: 売国王姫～堕落のメス豚母娘～
source:
Seirio, the land of fertility.

A small country on the edge of the continent, surrounded by mountains and forest.
Famous for being an agricultural country, the vegetables, fruits, and sake produced in Seirio
was highly praised in every nation and it was therefore called a country of fertility.

Two women who are considered to be the most beautiful jewels in Seirio.

――― Princess Fiana de Seirio.
――― Queen Emilia de Seirio.

Fiana and Emilia had a calm and happy life, loving the people from the bottom of their hearts and were loved by the people in return.

Although it is a small country, it has an abundance of blessings, so many countries used to aim for this land. By entering a patronage with the great power Elstein, it prevented the invasion from every country.

However, shortly after news broke out about the kingdom of Elstein, their only ally, had fallen, a man called the Gurda, the Barbarian King brought together the
barbarians and declared war from "Salvahe , the Barbarian Country. "

The conditions that Gulda gave to Seirio to prevent invasion:
"Dedicate the First Princess Fiana and the First Queen Emilia to the King of Salvahe." 

The beautiful princess and queen devoted themselves to the barbarian king in order to protect their beloved country.....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ318113.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
塞里奥，丰饶之国。

这是一个位于大陆边缘、被山林环绕的小国。
它以农业闻名，所产的蔬菜、水果与酒，
在各国都备受赞誉，因此被称为丰饶之国。

有两位女性，被视为塞里奥最美丽的珍宝。

——菲亚娜·德·塞里奥公主。
——艾米莉亚·德·塞里奥王后。

菲亚娜与艾米莉亚由衷地爱着国民，也深受国民爱戴，过着平静而幸福的生活。

这个国家虽小，却物产丰饶，一直受到诸国觊觎。凭借与强国埃尔斯坦建立的庇护关系，它才得以抵御各国的入侵。

然而，就在唯一的盟国埃尔斯坦王国覆灭的消息传来后不久，被称为“蛮族王”的古尔达便集结蛮族，以“蛮族之国萨尔瓦赫”的名义宣战。

古尔达向塞里奥开出了免遭入侵的条件。
“将第一公主菲亚娜与第一王后艾米莉亚，献给萨尔瓦赫国王。”

为了守护深爱的祖国，美丽的公主与王后，将自己献给了蛮族王……
